title: A string @fixed stays a string, on a bytes field as on a string field (YAML surface)
description: "CAFE" and "1234" are strings, not hex digits or a number: they are emitted as xsd:string literals, which the Processing Model compares with a bytes field as UTF-8 and with a UTF-16 string field by code points. The YAML mirror of the text document compiles to the same graph.
